# Forteca Estate

> Premium vacation rental and property management company serving Pennsylvania, New York, and Florida.

Forteca Estate is a licensed property management company based in Stroudsburg, PA. We offer direct-book vacation rentals, full-service property management, home staging, and real estate services across Pennsylvania, New York, and Florida. Book directly with us to save on fees.

- [Home](https://fortecaestate.com/): Overview of Forteca Estate's vacation rentals and property management services.
- [Properties](https://fortecaestate.com/properties): Browse all available vacation rental properties in Pennsylvania, New York, and Florida.
- [Services](https://fortecaestate.com/services): Full suite of property services including vacation rentals, property management, and home staging.
- [Vacation Rentals](https://fortecaestate.com/services/vacation-rentals): Short-term vacation rental management for property owners.
- [Property Management](https://fortecaestate.com/services/property-management): Full-service property management for investment property owners.
- [Home Staging](https://fortecaestate.com/services/home-staging): Professional home staging services for sellers and investors.
- [About](https://fortecaestate.com/about): About the Forteca Estate team and company background.
- [Blog](https://fortecaestate.com/blog): Travel tips, vacation guides, and rental insights from Forteca Estate.
- [Testimonials](https://fortecaestate.com/testimonials): Reviews and testimonials from guests and property owners.
